premise: On a grey morning Butterfly can't fly, her wings are too cold; Bee tries to fan her warm (brrr, colder!) and hums her a sunny tune, Pinecone waits with her, and when the clouds part they both open wide in the sun.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop), turned: blowing only makes it colder, and the warmth that works is the one you wait for together.
lesson: Some things can't be hurried, and waiting is easier with friends.
learning: Butterflies warm their wings in the sun before they can fly.

en-US.title: Butterfly Waits for the Sun
en-US.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7} {bee:float loop 0.3} [softly] It was a grey, cloudy morning. {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:go to meadow} Butterfly sat in the grass and tried to fly. {butterfly:live flap} Flap, flap… nothing. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] "My wings are too cold," she sighed. "I can't fly with cold wings." {bee:enter} Bee came buzzing by. {bee:face happy} {bee:go to butterfly} "I'll warm you up!" {sfx:buzz} Bzzz! {bee:live fan} She fanned her wings as fast as she could. {butterfly:tint #9AD0FF} "Brrr! That's even colder!" [giggles] So Bee {bee:live hum} hummed her sunniest tune. Still cold. Then along rolled {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to butterfly} Pinecone. [gently] "When it's cold, I wait for the sun." So they waited, all three together. {butterfly:live rest hold} Butterfly folded her wings. "Come out, sun," they whispered. "Come out, sun." {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s} Slowly, the clouds drifted away… and out came the sun, warm and golden. {butterfly:live rest resume} Butterfly opened her wings to the sun. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} Pinecone opened her scales. {butterfly:face happy} "Warm at last!" {butterfly:go to sky} {bee:go to butterfly} {sfx:flutter} Up she fluttered, {bee:face happy} {bee:hop x2} and Bee bobbed along beside her. [happily] And on grey mornings after that, three friends sat in the grass together, whispering: "Come out, sun."

es-ES.title: Mariposa espera al sol
es-ES.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7} {bee:float loop 0.3} [softly] Era una mañana gris, llena de nubes. {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:go to meadow} Mariposa, en la hierba, intentó volar. {butterfly:live flap} Aleteó y aleteó… y nada. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] —Tengo las alas heladas —suspiró—. Y con las alas frías no puedo volar. {bee:enter} Abeja pasaba zumbando. {bee:face happy} {bee:go to butterfly} —¡Yo te las caliento! {sfx:buzz} ¡Bzzz! {bee:live fan} Y le hizo aire rapidísimo. {butterfly:tint #9AD0FF} —¡Brrr! ¡Ahora tengo más frío! [giggles] Así que Abeja {bee:live hum} le tarareó su canción más soleada. Ni por esas. Entonces llegó rodando {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to butterfly} Piña. [gently] —Cuando hace frío, yo espero al sol. Y esperaron las tres juntas. {butterfly:live rest hold} Mariposa plegó las alas. —Sol, solito —susurraban—, caliéntanos un poquito. {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s} Poco a poco, las nubes se fueron… y salió el sol, dorado y calentito. {butterfly:live rest resume} Mariposa abrió las alas al sol. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} Piña abrió sus escamas. {butterfly:face happy} —¡Por fin, calentita! {butterfly:go to sky} {bee:go to butterfly} {sfx:flutter} Y echó a volar, {bee:face happy} {bee:hop x2} con Abeja dando botes a su lado. [happily] Y desde entonces, las mañanas grises, tres amigas se sientan en la hierba y susurran: «Sol, solito, caliéntanos un poquito».

ja-JP.title: おひさま、でておいで
ja-JP.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7}{bee:float loop 0.3}[softly]くもった、はいいろの朝。{butterfly:enter}{butterfly:go to meadow}チョウチョさんは、くさの上。{butterfly:live flap}とぼうとしても、ぱた、ぱた…だめ。{butterfly:face sad}[sad]「はねがつめたくて、とべないの。」 {bee:enter}ミツバチさんが、とんできました。{bee:face happy}{bee:go to butterfly}「あたためてあげる！」 {sfx:buzz}ブーン！{bee:live fan}はねで、いっしょうけんめいあおぎます。{butterfly:tint #9AD0FF}「ぶるる！もっとさむい！」 [giggles]そこでミツバチさんは、{bee:live hum}いちばんぽかぽかの歌をはなうた。やっぱり、さむい。そこへ、ころころ{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to butterfly}まつぼっくり。[gently]「さむいときは、おひさまをまつの。」 そこで、みんなでまちました。{butterfly:live rest hold}チョウチョさんは、はねをとじて。「おひさま、おひさま、でておいで。」 {canvas:clouds stop}{canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s}くもが、ゆっくりながれていって…ぽかぽか、金いろのおひさま！{butterfly:live rest resume}チョウチョさんは、おひさまにはねをひろげました。{pinecone:face happy}{pinecone:live open hold}まつぼっくりも、かさをひらきます。{butterfly:face happy}「やっと、あったかい！」 {butterfly:go to sky}{bee:go to butterfly}{sfx:flutter}ひらひら、そらへ。{bee:face happy}{bee:hop x2}ミツバチさんも、となりでぴょこぴょこ。[happily]それからは、くもりの朝は、三人ならんでささやきます。「おひさま、おひさま、でておいで。」

de-DE.title: Der Schmetterling wartet auf die Sonne
de-DE.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7} {bee:float loop 0.3} [softly] Es war ein grauer, wolkiger Morgen. {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:go to meadow} Der Schmetterling saß im Gras und wollte losfliegen. {butterfly:live flap} Flatter, flatter… nichts. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] „Meine Flügel sind zu kalt“, seufzte er. „Mit kalten Flügeln kann ich nicht fliegen.“ {bee:enter} Die Biene kam vorbeigesummt. {bee:face happy} {bee:go to butterfly} „Ich wärme dich!“ {sfx:buzz} Summ, summ! {bee:live fan} Sie fächelte ihm Luft zu, so schnell sie konnte. {butterfly:tint #9AD0FF} „Brrr! Jetzt ist mir noch kälter!“ [giggles] Also {bee:live hum} summte die Biene ihr sonnigstes Lied. Immer noch kalt. Da kam {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to butterfly} der Tannenzapfen angerollt. [gently] „Wenn es kalt ist, warte ich auf die Sonne.“ Also warteten sie zu dritt. {butterfly:live rest hold} Der Schmetterling klappte die Flügel zu. „Sonne, Sonne, komm heraus“, flüsterten sie. „Sonne, Sonne, komm heraus.“ {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s} Langsam zogen die Wolken weiter… und heraus kam die Sonne, warm und golden. {butterfly:live rest resume} Der Schmetterling breitete die Flügel aus. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} Der Tannenzapfen öffnete seine Schuppen. {butterfly:face happy} „Endlich warm!“ {butterfly:go to sky} {bee:go to butterfly} {sfx:flutter} Er flatterte hinauf, {bee:face happy} {bee:hop x2} die Biene tanzte neben ihm her. [happily] Seitdem sitzen die drei an grauen Morgen im Gras und flüstern: „Sonne, Sonne, komm heraus.“

fr-FR.title: Papillon attend le soleil
fr-FR.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7} {bee:float loop 0.3} [softly] C’était un matin gris et nuageux. {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:go to meadow} Papillon, dans l’herbe, essayait de voler. {butterfly:live flap} Flap, flap… rien. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] « Mes ailes sont trop froides pour voler », a-t-il soupiré. {bee:enter} Abeille passait en bourdonnant. {bee:face happy} {bee:go to butterfly} « Je vais te réchauffer ! » {sfx:buzz} Bzzz ! {bee:live fan} Et elle a battu des ailes à toute vitesse. {butterfly:tint #9AD0FF} « Brrr ! Encore plus froid ! » [giggles] Alors Abeille {bee:live hum} a fredonné sa chanson la plus ensoleillée. Toujours froid. Puis {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to butterfly} Pomme de pin est arrivée en roulant. [gently] « Quand il fait froid, j’attends le soleil. » Ils ont attendu tous les trois. {butterfly:live rest hold} Papillon a replié ses ailes. « Soleil, soleil, montre ton nez », chuchotaient-ils. « Soleil, soleil, montre ton nez. » {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s} Doucement, les nuages sont partis… et voilà le soleil, chaud et doré. {butterfly:live rest resume} Papillon a ouvert ses ailes au soleil. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} Pomme de pin a ouvert ses écailles. {butterfly:face happy} « Enfin au chaud ! » {butterfly:go to sky} {bee:go to butterfly} {sfx:flutter} Il s’est envolé, {bee:face happy} {bee:hop x2} et Abeille dansait à ses côtés. [happily] Et depuis, les matins gris, trois amis chuchotent ensemble dans l’herbe : « Soleil, soleil, montre ton nez. »

it-IT.title: Farfalla aspetta il sole
it-IT.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7} {bee:float loop 0.3} [softly] Era una mattina grigia e nuvolosa. {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:go to meadow} Farfalla se ne stava nell'erba e provava a volare. {butterfly:live flap} Ha sbattuto le ali, una volta, due volte… niente. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] «Ho le ali troppo fredde», ha sospirato. «Con le ali fredde non si vola.» {bee:enter} Ape è passata di lì, ronzando. {bee:face happy} {bee:go to butterfly} «Ti scaldo io!» {sfx:buzz} Bzzz! {bee:live fan} Ha sventolato le ali più veloce che poteva. {butterfly:tint #9AD0FF} «Brrr! Così è ancora più freddo!» [giggles] Allora Ape {bee:live hum} ha canticchiato la sua canzone più allegra. Niente, sempre freddo. Poi è arrivata rotolando {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to butterfly} Pigna. [gently] «Quando fa freddo, io aspetto il sole.» Così hanno aspettato, tutte e tre insieme. {butterfly:live rest hold} Farfalla ha chiuso le ali. «Esci, sole bello», sussurravano, «scalda il praticello.» {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s} Piano piano, le nuvole se ne sono andate… ed è uscito il sole, caldo e dorato. {butterfly:live rest resume} Farfalla ha aperto le ali al sole. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} Pigna ha aperto le sue squame. {butterfly:face happy} «Finalmente al calduccio!» {butterfly:go to sky} {bee:go to butterfly} {sfx:flutter} Ed è volata su, {bee:face happy} {bee:hop x2} con Ape che ballonzolava lì accanto. [happily] E da allora, nelle mattine grigie, tre amiche si siedono insieme nell'erba e sussurrano: «Esci, sole bello, scalda il praticello.»

zh-TW.title: 蝴蝶等太陽
zh-TW.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7}{bee:float loop 0.3}[softly]一個灰濛濛的早晨。{butterfly:enter}{butterfly:go to meadow}蝴蝶坐在草地上，想要飛。{butterfly:live flap}拍拍、拍拍……飛不起來。{butterfly:face sad}[sad]「我的翅膀太冷了。」 牠嘆氣說，「翅膀冷冰冰，就飛不起來。」 {bee:enter}蜜蜂嗡嗡嗡地飛過來。{bee:face happy}{bee:go to butterfly}「我來幫你暖一暖！」 {sfx:buzz}嗡嗡嗡！{bee:live fan}牠拚命地搧翅膀。{butterfly:tint #9AD0FF}「哇，好冷！比剛才還冷！」 [giggles]於是蜜蜂{bee:live hum}哼起最有陽光味道的歌。還是好冷。這時，{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to butterfly}松果骨碌碌地滾了過來。[gently]「天冷的時候，我就等太陽。」 於是，三個好朋友一起等。{butterfly:live rest hold}蝴蝶合起翅膀。大家小聲地唱：「太陽公公快出來，暖暖陽光照過來。」 {canvas:clouds stop}{canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s}慢慢的，雲飄走了……金黃的太陽，暖暖地出來了。{butterfly:live rest resume}蝴蝶對著太陽張開翅膀。{pinecone:face happy}{pinecone:live open hold}松果也打開了她的鱗片。{butterfly:face happy}「終於暖和了！」 {butterfly:go to sky}{bee:go to butterfly}{sfx:flutter}蝴蝶輕輕飛了起來，{bee:face happy}{bee:hop x2}蜜蜂也在旁邊一跳一跳地飛。[happily]從此以後，每到灰灰的早晨，三個好朋友就坐在草地上，小小聲地唱：「太陽公公快出來，暖暖陽光照過來。」

zh-HK.title: 蝴蝶等太陽伯伯
zh-HK.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7}{bee:float loop 0.3}[softly]這天早上，天灰灰的，雲很多。{butterfly:enter}{butterfly:go to meadow}蝴蝶坐在草地上，想飛起來。{butterfly:live flap}拍拍、拍拍……還是飛不起。{butterfly:face sad}[sad]「我對翼太凍喇，」 牠嘆氣說，「翼凍冰冰，點飛呀？」 {bee:enter}蜜蜂嗡嗡嗡地飛過來。{bee:face happy}{bee:go to butterfly}「等我幫你暖吓佢！」 {sfx:buzz}嗡嗡嗡！{bee:live fan}牠拚命地拍動翅膀。{butterfly:tint #9AD0FF}「嘩，好凍呀！仲凍過頭先！」 [giggles]於是蜜蜂{bee:live hum}哼起牠最暖洋洋的歌。還是很冷。這時，{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to butterfly}松果骨碌骨碌地滾了過來。[gently]「天冷嘅時候，我就等太陽。」 於是，三個好朋友一起等。{butterfly:live rest hold}蝴蝶合起翅膀。大家輕輕地說：「太陽伯伯，出嚟啦。太陽伯伯，出嚟啦。」 {canvas:clouds stop}{canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s}慢慢地，雲飄走了……金黃色的太陽，暖暖地出來了。{butterfly:live rest resume}蝴蝶對着太陽張開翅膀。{pinecone:face happy}{pinecone:live open hold}松果也張開了她的鱗片。{butterfly:face happy}「終於暖返喇！」 {butterfly:go to sky}{bee:go to butterfly}{sfx:flutter}蝴蝶輕輕飛上天空，{bee:face happy}{bee:hop x2}蜜蜂也一上一下地陪着牠飛。[happily]從此以後，每逢灰灰的早上，三個好朋友都會坐在草地上，輕輕地說：「太陽伯伯，出嚟啦。」

buzz.prompt: a small bee buzzing close by, wings whirring fast, realistic

flutter.prompt: a butterfly's soft wings fluttering, very light and close
